final_result:
I have searched YouTube for 'beginner-friendly personal productivity' videos. I found the following three relevant videos:

1.  Title: Beginner-Friendly Workflow for Work & Life | Stay Organized with TickTick, Creator: TickTick
2.  Title: My Simple Productivity System (for normal people)!, Creator: Jeff Su
3.  Title: being productive is easy, actually, Creator: easy, actually

I was unable to confirm the presence of an account avatar as requested, as only 'Sign in' links were visible in the UI.

UX Likes:
*   Search autocomplete provided helpful suggestions.
*   Video results clearly displayed title, creator, views, and upload date.
*   Chapter markers on some videos aided content preview.

UX Dislikes:
*   Redundant 'Sign in' prompts were visible despite being signed in.
*   The 'Filters' button was not immediately prominent.

Ease: Easy.
